name: Common Rules & Hints

quick_facts.prefer: pnpm nx targets; avoid long-running dev servers unless asked

common_commands.serve: pnpm nx run-many -t serve --projects=api,frontend (API: http://localhost:3000, Frontend: http://localhost:4200)

steps: Ensure DB up to date (run pending migrations first)
Update entity definitions to reflect desired schema
rules: Always base migrations on auto-generated ones. Generate first, then edit
Cleanup is mandatory. Auto-generated migrations often include more changes than needed and may apply them ineffectively. After generating, review and trim to only intended schema changes

precommit_ci.api_client: If pnpm precommit regenerates the API client, accept those changes and commit together. Never revert. Never manually edit generated API clients; only update via regeneration.

common_mistakes: Running long-running dev servers when not asked
Reverting API client regeneration from precommit
Writing migrations by hand instead of generating then cleaning up
